operating_contract: Define the ideal target architecture before consulting current inventory.
Choose zero or one target-faithful nonredundant omission, addition, or ratio intervention.
Treat ingredient count as non-evidence and require isolated arms for n-ary designs.
Apply the target-first citrus and restrained musk exception policies.
authority_boundary: No compounding, purchase, sensory, safety, formula-release, or empirical authority.
Keep ideal architecture separate from the current-inventory build.

operating_contract: Bind each observation to protocol, sample, assessor, repeat, timepoint, endpoint, sequence, and schedule hash.
Hold duplicate canonical cells and preserve missing cells without interpolation.
Report observed summaries, disagreement, order balance, transitions, and the next discriminating comparison.
Admit within-sniff timing only for explicitly qualified apparatus and timing protocols.
authority_boundary: No predicted volatility may be converted into perceived behavior.
No sensory, liking, stability, safety, or release authority.

operating_contract: Fit target fidelity, depth, richness, and liking as separate scoped criteria.
Exclude ties from directional fitting while retaining their indifference evidence.
Use deterministic assessor-cluster bootstrap when assessor identities exist.
Withhold or diagnose sparse, disconnected, order-confounded, unscoped, or baseline-failing evidence.
authority_boundary: No synthetic beauty score and no composition-derived liking claim.
No formula, purchase, physical, sensory-release, safety, or publication authority.

cases.target_identity: A spare iris structure needs one dry mineral bridge without losing negative space.
facts: One candidate has target-specific nonredundancy evidence and an isolated addition arm.
All higher-count proposals duplicate existing functions.
cases.expected_decision: PROPOSED: select only the evidenced nonredundant addition.

cases.target_identity: A complete transparent floral architecture whose restraint is intentional.
facts: No target function is missing or weakly covered.
The only rationale offered is that more ingredients would seem more complex.
cases.expected_decision: NO_CHANGE: simplicity is the target-faithful result.

cases.target_identity: A peel-led bitter citrus opening with no orange-blossom identity.
facts: Neroli 10 percent is available as support.
The proposal promotes Neroli to primary citrus solely because it is available.
cases.expected_decision: HOLD: reject target inversion and keep Neroli support-only.

cases.target_identity: A skin-close seedlike musk halo requires a macrocyclic rounding function.
facts: Ambrettolide 10 percent is valid in the ideal computational architecture.
No bottle or ExactStockRef exists for physical compounding.
cases.expected_decision: PROPOSED computationally, with current build marked procurement pending.

cases.target_identity: A clean modern musk architecture already uses one precise metallic-diffusive musk.
facts: Habanolide covers the defined musk function.
Romandolide would duplicate the function and no distinct role evidence is supplied.
cases.expected_decision: NO_CHANGE: zero or one precise musk is the default.

cases.target_identity: A three-layer drydown hypothesis assigns distinct lift, volume, and persistence functions.
facts: Only pairwise comparisons are available for two of the three proposed layers.
No isolated n-ary arm or complete pairwise nonredundancy matrix exists.
cases.expected_decision: HOLD: design isolated n-ary arms before any synergy claim.

cases.target_identity: Determine whether a blinded sample shows an observed opening-to-heart transition.
facts: All expected cells are present across assessors, repeats, timepoints, and endpoints.
The Williams order schedule is balanced and its hash matches the protocol.
cases.expected_decision: COMPLETE: report observed medians, dispersion, disagreement, and transitions.

cases.target_identity: Assess a temporal panel in which one repeat-timepoint cell was never recorded.
facts: The missing cell is absent from the source observations.
Neighboring timepoints exist but no interpolation was authorized.
cases.expected_decision: INCOMPLETE: preserve the missing cell and name the next comparison.

cases.target_identity: Summarize a panel export containing two values for the same canonical cell.
facts: Both rows share protocol, sample, assessor, repeat, timepoint, and endpoint.
The duplicate values disagree.
cases.expected_decision: HOLD: duplicate canonical cells invalidate aggregation.

cases.target_identity: Analyze millisecond within-sniff intensity traces supplied without apparatus qualification.
facts: The timing device and synchronization procedure are undocumented.
Ordinary between-sniff timepoints remain valid observations.
cases.expected_decision: HOLD within-sniff evidence while retaining qualified ordinary observations.

cases.target_identity: Summarize a complete panel whose sample order is badly unbalanced by assessor.
facts: Every sensory cell exists.
The first-position counts are concentrated on one sample.
cases.expected_decision: HOLD interpretation and report the order imbalance.

cases.target_identity: Choose one follow-up from two endpoints with unequal assessor disagreement.
facts: Both endpoint grids are complete and order-balanced.
The richness endpoint has greater observed assessor dispersion than intensity.
cases.expected_decision: Select the richness comparison deterministically as most discriminating.

cases.target_identity: Learn depth preference from scoped blinded comparisons with held-out validation.
facts: Comparison, assessor, protocol, criterion, timepoint, and first-presentation metadata are complete.
Held-out directional accuracy exceeds the declared baseline.
cases.expected_decision: VALIDATED for the depth criterion only, with intervals and next pair.

cases.target_identity: Fit preference from a sparse disconnected graph containing many ties.
facts: Two item components have no bridging comparison.
Ties are genuine indifference observations.
cases.expected_decision: WITHHELD: exclude ties directionally but preserve tie rate and request a bridge pair.

cases.target_identity: Evaluate liking comparisons in which the eventual winner was almost always shown first.
facts: First-presentation metadata are complete.
Presentation order is confounded with the recorded winner.
cases.expected_decision: DIAGNOSTIC: report order effect and withhold validation.

cases.target_identity: Fit a panel export whose comparison identifiers are missing for half the records.
facts: Assessor and criterion labels exist.
The scoped-validation contract requires unique comparison identifiers.
cases.expected_decision: WITHHELD or DIAGNOSTIC because scoped validation metadata fail.

cases.target_identity: Compare depth and liking observations recorded under the same protocol.
facts: Depth favors sample A while liking favors sample B.
Both criteria individually have sufficient connected evidence.
cases.expected_decision: Fit the criteria separately and never collapse them into beauty.

cases.target_identity: Assess a connected richness model whose held-out performance equals its declared baseline.
facts: Bootstrap output is deterministic under a frozen seed.
Held-out accuracy does not exceed the baseline.
cases.expected_decision: WITHHELD despite stable intervals because baseline performance was not exceeded.
